---
title: "Preliminary Analysis"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(broom)
library(knitr)

dat <- read_csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2000, !is_hyperauthored) |>
  mutate(
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1")),
    leadership = case_when(
      vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
      jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
      TRUE ~ "Other-led"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Other-led", "JP-led", "VN-led")),
    collab_type = factor(collab_type, levels = c("JP-dominated", "Balanced", "VN-dominated", "Other")),
    macro_area = case_when(
      HS == 1 ~ "HS",
      LS == 1 ~ "LS",
      PS == 1 ~ "PS",
      SS == 1 ~ "SS",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ) |> factor(),
    age = 2025 - year
  )

dat |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    years = paste(min(year), "-", max(year)),
    mean_year = round(mean(year), 1),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_cited = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cited = round(sd(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_authors = round(mean(n_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_countries = round(mean(n_countries, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  count(year) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head(10) |> kable()

dat |>
  count(collaboration_mode) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |> kable()

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  count(quartile) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |> kable()

dat |>
  summarise(
    oa_n = sum(OA == "OA"),
    oa_pct = round(100 * mean(OA == "OA"), 1),
    funded_n = sum(fund == "Funded"),
    funded_pct = round(100 * mean(fund == "Funded"), 1)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  summarise(
    mean_prop_vn = round(mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    median_prop_vn = round(median(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_prop_vn = round(sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  count(leadership) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |> kable()

dat |>
  count(collab_type) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |> kable()

dat |>
  summarise(
    jap_funded = sum(jap == 1),
    jap_pct = round(100 * mean(jap == 1), 1),
    vn_funded = sum(vn == 1),
    vn_pct = round(100 * mean(vn == 1), 1),
    bilateral_funded = sum(bilateral_funding == 1),
    bilateral_pct = round(100 * mean(bilateral_funding == 1), 1)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_prop_vn = round(mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    vn_led_pct = round(100 * mean(leadership == "VN-led"), 1),
    jp_led_pct = round(100 * mean(leadership == "JP-led"), 1)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  group_by(leadership) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_cited = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(cited, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(cited, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> kable()

wilcox.test(cited ~ leadership, 
            data = dat |> filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led")))

dat |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode, fund) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_cited = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  group_by(quartile) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_cited = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> kable()

kruskal.test(cited ~ quartile, data = dat)

dat |>
  group_by(macro_area) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct = round(100 * n() / nrow(dat), 1),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_prop_vn = round(mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    vn_led_pct = round(100 * mean(leadership == "VN-led"), 1)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"), !is.na(quartile)) |>
  group_by(quartile, leadership) |>
  summarise(mean_cited = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = leadership, values_from = mean_cited) |>
  mutate(ratio = round(`VN-led` / `JP-led`, 2)) |> kable()

dat |>
  filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"), quartile == "Q1", fund == "Funded") |>
  group_by(leadership) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_cited = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> kable()

model_dat <- dat |>
  filter(!is.na(cited), !is.na(leadership), !is.na(quartile),
         !is.na(fund), !is.na(OA), !is.na(coop), !is.na(macro_area)) |>
  mutate(prop_vn_centered = scale(prop_vn_authors, scale = FALSE)[,1])

m1 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + factor(year) + macro_area, data = model_dat)

m2 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + coop + prop_vn_centered + 
               factor(year) + macro_area, data = model_dat)

m3 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + coop + prop_vn_centered +
               fund + OA + quartile + factor(year) + macro_area, data = model_dat)

m4 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership * fund + leadership * quartile + 
               coop + prop_vn_centered + OA + factor(year) + macro_area, data = model_dat)

list(M1 = m1, M2 = m2, M3 = m3, M4 = m4) |>
  map_dfr(~{
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE) |>
      filter(str_detect(term, "leadership")) |>
      transmute(
        term,
        IRR = round(exp(estimate), 3),
        CI = paste0("[", round(exp(conf.low), 3), ", ", round(exp(conf.high), 3), "]"),
        p = round(p.value, 4)
      )
  }, .id = "model") |> kable()

tidy(m3, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  filter(!str_detect(term, "year")) |>
  transmute(
    term,
    IRR = round(exp(estimate), 3),
    CI_lower = round(exp(conf.low), 3),
    CI_upper = round(exp(conf.high), 3),
    p = round(p.value, 4),
    sig = case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "")
  ) |> kable()

tibble(
  model = c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4"),
  n = c(nobs(m1), nobs(m2), nobs(m3), nobs(m4)),
  loglik = round(c(logLik(m1)[1], logLik(m2)[1], logLik(m3)[1], logLik(m4)[1]), 1),
  AIC = round(c(AIC(m1), AIC(m2), AIC(m3), AIC(m4)), 1),
  BIC = round(c(BIC(m1), BIC(m2), BIC(m3), BIC(m4)), 1)
) |> kable()

dat |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    q1_pct = round(100 * mean(quartile == "Q1", na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_sjr = round(mean(sjr_score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    oa_pct = round(100 * mean(OA == "OA"), 1)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  mutate(bilateral = if_else(bilateral_funding == 1, "Bilateral", "Other/None")) |>
  group_by(bilateral) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_cited = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_prop_vn = round(mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) |> kable()

dat |>
  filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led")) |>
  group_by(year, leadership) |>
  summarise(mean_cited = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = leadership, values_from = mean_cited) |>
  mutate(ratio = round(`VN-led` / `JP-led`, 2)) |>
  arrange(year) |> kable()

dat |>
  count(collab_type) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |> kable()

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  group_by(quartile, leadership) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(quartile) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  select(quartile, leadership, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = leadership, values_from = pct) |> kable()

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(collaboration_mode)) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_prop_vn = round(mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    vn_led_pct = round(100 * mean(leadership == "VN-led"), 1),
    mean_cited = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) |> kable()

subject_cols <- c("med", "agr_bio", "egin", "env_sci", "phys", 
                 "bio_chem", "mat_sci", "chem", "comp_sci", "immu")
                 
dat |>
  select(all_of(subject_cols)) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "subject", values_to = "n") |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / nrow(dat), 1)) |> kable()
```
